title: Benowitz builds receivers to intercept base transmissions
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he built apparently a setup and started listening to transmissions coming from the base,

plain: Around 1979 to 1981, a man named Paul Bennewitz is said to have built his own receiving equipment and started listening in on transmissions from Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico. A researcher named Greg Bishop tells Michels this on an episode about how, in its own title, aliens drove Bennewitz insane, and he gives no source beyond saying that this is apparently what happened.
